oracle: sbx duplicate custom secrets: when sbx lists more than one global custom secret for the USAi env var and host, `secret set -g usai` refuses before anything is stored. acq cannot tell which placeholder the running sandboxes hold, so the refusal names every placeholder, prints one `sbx secret rm --placeholder P -f` per entry, warns that a running sandbox may hold one of them, and removes nothing

error.message: sbx lists 2 global custom secrets for $USAI_API_KEY on api.gsa.usai.gov, so acq cannot tell which one your sandboxes use (placeholders: sbx-cs-dup-1, sbx-cs-dup-2)
error.remediation: nothing was stored; warning: a running sandbox may hold one of these placeholders, and a sandbox whose placeholder you remove can no longer reach api.gsa.usai.gov until it is recreated or rebound as ADR-0008 describes; remove the entries your sandboxes do not use (one command per entry: 'sbx secret rm --placeholder sbx-cs-dup-1 -f', 'sbx secret rm --placeholder sbx-cs-dup-2 -f'), then run 'acq usai-rotate-api-key' to update the entry you keep (or 'acq secret set -g usai' after removing them all)
